name: Apollonian
description: Two fractal distance fields - a sine-folded lattice and an Apollonian sphere packing - lit from inside by a moving point light, with a reflection pass. The most expensive effect in the library; it earns a showcase section, not a whole video.

speed.description: Master rate. Drives the camera orbit directly, and the fold below through it.

churn.description: How fast the packing folds through itself, as a fraction of speed. The angle is re-applied to space that has already been inverted five times, so small values go a long way - past ~0.4 the structure strobes instead of moving. 0 leaves a still fractal that the camera orbits.

steps.description: Primary march steps. The main cost lever - drop this first if the render rate suffers.

glow.description: Intensity of the point light buried in the structure.

reflect.description: Contribution of the reflection march. At 0 the surfaces go flat.

tint.description: Blend the light colour toward the project palette.
